snippet.title: Version "Luna I" "A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves" Trailer | Genshin Impact
snippet.description:
Version "Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue" "A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves" Trailer | Genshin Impact
Wayfarer who has traveled the world, perhaps this is your first time here.
Enjoy the wine and revelry beneath the gentle moon's gaze.
But beware too, of the spirits and lies, and the cold moon's pallid rays.

VA:
Aether —Zach Aguilar
Flins —Nic Olsen
Sandrone, Fatui Harbinger. Codename: "Marionette" — Deneen Melody
Dori — Anjali Kunapaneni
Nefer — Ashleigh Haddad
Ineffa — Angelina Danielle Cama
Aino — Annabel Brook
Lauma — Alexandra Guelff
"Moon Maiden" Columbina — Emi Lo
Jahoda — Sonya Krueger
Lumine — Sarah Miller-Crews
